Anya: Quick huddle recap — we need explicit launch criteria for VPC/on-prem private deploys; customers keep asking about upgrade path and networking ownership. Who's in to define minimal installer + upgrade story? @Leo @Marcus @Tia

Leo: I'll take installer presets. thinking minimal + standard. Minimal = bootstrap only, no auto-update, tenant IPs preserved.

Marcus: runtime team ok with that. minimal must support: KV cache migration, db schema no-migrate flag.

Tia: field note from Acme: must support customer-managed NAT and not require IP renumbering. :warning:

Leo: installer draft options:
- minimal (offline-friendly)
- managed (autoscale hooks + k8s operator)
We can do both as flavours.

Anya: Acceptance criteria draft:
- Installer preset names & docs written
- Upgrade path documented (in-place operator + canary lanes)
- Rollback <= 30m for committed upgrades
- Netops handoff doc + runbook
- KMS/HSM integration tests green

Marcus: For upgrade path prefer operator-driven rolling with canary traffic. fallback to previous model variant if runtime failure.

Tia: Also add "no customer-visible IP churn" to launch gates.

deploy-bot: CI: installer-image: refs/heads/main build succeeded (artifact id: art-20260321-78)

Leo: I'll prototype minimal installer by EOW and post PR.

Anya: OK — owners + deadlines:
- Leo: installer presets & docs (EOW)
- Marcus: operator upgrade playbook & metrics (next Wed)
- Tia: field runbook + customer constraints (Thu)
I'll file a follow-up in product/roadmap and tag you.

Marcus: one more: include upgrade QoS SLOs (latency degradation <= 10% during canary).

Tia: Adding that. Also request: template customer comms for onprem upgrades.

Anya: Thanks team. I'll add these as launch gates and schedule a 15m sync on Friday. :calendar:
